description: Site Characterization of Strong-Motion Station N4.N62A, Caumsett State Historic Park Preserve, Lloyd Harbor, New York is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Patrick Daniele, University of Rhode Island (uri.edu). This dataset contains the geophysical site characterization data collected at Caumsett State Historic Park on the northern shore of Long Island, New York, at the location of strong-motion station N4.N62A. Coverage: 6 km ESE of Califon, New Jersey. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: surface wave testing, geophysical methods, earthquake, seismic testing, Caumsett State Historic Park, hazard assessment. Published 2026-09-25. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
